Alex (Partnerships): quick heads-up — for the Partner Summit next month we have 3 satellite demo circuits running during breaks. need to lock speaker handoffs + swag pick-up points. who can own run-of-show for the mini-stage?
Maya - Events: I can own run-of-show for the morning slot (10:30–12:30). will need final speaker list by next Tue and exact kit weights for shipping. :truck:
Samir (Sales Eng): I can handle demos & kit dry-run. please confirm we have 2 GPU loaners + streaming encoder for each circuit. also need a fallback script if a model fallback is required.
Jordan - Product: putting together a 5min script to highlight routing/fallback. can someone share the canary model id and a short note on acceptable latency degradation?
Alex (Partnerships): model id for the demo is redwood-demo-v2-quant. acceptable latency for the demo runway is <=120ms p50, tell Jordan p95 can be relaxed to 300ms for live fallback.
Maya - Events: shipping deadline for international swag is EOD Friday. can we reduce the swag box to 12 items per kit? customs paperwork needs a content list.
Samir (Sales Eng): 12 items is fine. contents: 1 sticker pack, 1 mini-guide, 1 USB-C cable, 1 notebook, 1 postcard, 1 demo voucher card. I’ll add a small QR with live demo link.
Jordan - Product: for fallback script: snippet to show in slides and on kiosk if model switches. keeping it short: "If latency rises, app will route to redwood-lite-v1 (quantized) — responses may be shorter." happy to draft visuals.
OpsBot: checklist created: 
```
- confirm 2x A5000 loaners per circuit
- encoder: Atem Mini Pro or equivalent
- network: dedicated VLAN + 100Mbps burst
- swag: 12x kits per circuit -> manifest.csv
- run-of-show doc: /drive/partner-summit/runofshow_v3.pdf
```
Maya - Events: tagging @Logistics for courier pick-up — Alex can you confirm warehouse window?
Alex (Partnerships): warehouse window OK Wed 09:00–17:00. courier: SwiftLogistics (tracking: https://swiftship.example/track/REDW-3321). please upload manifest.csv by Thu noon.
Samir (Sales Eng): can we add a short QR-led fallback demo that shows model-level switch? I can prepare a tiny local server and a Docker image. Anyone have objection to running ephemeral container on the demo laptop?
Jordan - Product: no objection. just ensure the container image is scanned and we have a simple health-check endpoint. suggested endpoint: `/healthz` returning 200|json.
Maya - Events: I'll set a 30min tech check slot day-before for each circuit. Samir, Jordan — bring 2 copies of the demo image and one USB with the latest checkpoints.
Alex (Partnerships): perfect. final asks: Samir to produce fallback script + docker image link by Fri, Jordan to finalize slides by Fri EOD, Maya to upload shipping manifest Thu noon. tagging timeline here so we all see it. :calendar: :ship:
